Prerequisite: Must have Quick Spender

As a reaction against any hostile action taken against you, you can materialize one of your receipts for twice the cursed energy cost in a surprise attack. If using an object, you force the creature to make a Dexterity saving throw at disadvantage if they are within range. On a failure, they take bludgeoning damage depending on the object’s size. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage. If using a weapon, you can make an attack with the weapon against the attacker at advantage if they are within range. At 11th level, this can be used with Contractual Control with only the one Object or Weapon used as part of this reaction.
